answer: To raise Sybil cost, each identity locks a bond that depreciates unless refreshed by sequential non-parallelizable proofs drawn from a public randomness river. Proofs must form a continuous karst of attested work; any gap drops standing toward nadir and freezes rewards. One agent can sustain only one such stream at full rate, so N clones demand N-fold continuous compute and capital, making mass forgery unprofitable.
